resources.string: Zero UI SOS gesture is on — pressing the volume-down button three times quickly triggers the emergency flow

Lets Zero UI detect the SOS gesture (pressing the volume-down button three times quickly) even when the app is in the background or the screen is locked, so the emergency flow can start without touching the screen. The service only listens for button presses — it cannot read the screen, notifications, or anything you type, and it cannot tap or control the phone for you.
